events.name: Portland Timbers at Chicago Fire FC

headlines.description: Dje D'Avilla had a goal and an assist in the first 14 minutes as Chicago Fire FC spoiled the debut of Portland Timbers coach Martí Cifuentes with a 2-1 victory on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chicago spoils Cifuentes' debut in win over Portland

events.name: Philadelphia Union at New York City FC

headlines.description: Bruno Damiani scored his first two goals of the season, 16-year-old Cavan Sullivan had two assists and the Philadelphia Union rallied from two goals down to beat New York City FC 3-2 on Sunday night at Yankee Stadium.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sullivan assists on 2 in Union rally over NYCFC
